example:
1. 2019

    Founded

    Two designers start the studio.

  2. 2024

    Twenty people

    The team moves into its own office.

usage.useWhen: Milestones in order, such as company history or a project schedule, also stages without a year ("First journey", "Heading east") with a free label.
usage.avoidWhen: Steps a reader follows to get something done; use an ordered list or the wizard block.
usage.a11y: The timeline is an ordered list; each date is a time element with a machine-readable datetime, a label without date is plain text.
